jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, GEO Card Present / In-Person Payments
jobs.description:

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Senior Product Manager, GEO Card Present / In-Person Payments

About your role:
You will lead global Card Present and in-person payment capabilities that support merchant payment experiences across terminals, payment applications, gateways and omnichannel commerce. You will work with engineering, architecture, operations, implementation, certification, sales and regional product teams to translate market needs into production-ready solutions. Your work will help expand payment products across countries and regions while improving merchant and consumer payment experiences.

What you'll do:
- Own Card Present and in-person payment initiatives from discovery, requirements and prioritization through development, testing, launch, adoption and product evolution.
- Translate customer, market and regional payment needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, customer journeys and solution requirements.
- Partner with engineering and architecture teams throughout the delivery lifecycle to clarify requirements, resolve issues, manage tradeoffs and remove delivery blockers.
- Drive product delivery across payment terminals, terminal applications, gateways, acquiring platforms, payment platforms and omnichannel commerce experiences.
- Support geographic expansion by defining regional payment requirements, local payment capabilities, certification needs and market-specific product requirements.
- Manage dependencies across platforms, teams, partners, vendors and geographies to support deployable, supportable and scalable product launches.
- Use customer feedback, production insights, market trends and business priorities to prioritize backlog items, release plans and ongoing product improvements.
- Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:
- 8+ years of experience in product management within payments, fintech, merchant acquiring, commerce or related financial technology.
- 6+ years of experience with Card Present or in-person payment solutions, including payment terminals, point-of-sale (POS) device ecosystems, terminal applications or payment platform integrations.
- 6+ years of experience defining product requirements for payment transaction lifecycles, including authorization, clearing, settlement, refunds, reversals and exception scenarios.
- 6+ years of experience working with payment gateways, processors, acquirers, payment platforms or omnichannel payment experiences.
- 4+ years of experience participating in Agile product delivery, including backlog ownership, prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, demos, testing and release readiness.
- 4+ years of experience launching or expanding payment products across multiple countries, regions, platforms or partner ecosystems.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:
- Experience with Europay, Mastercard and Visa (EMV) Level 2 or Level 3 certification.
- Experience with Alternative Payment Methods (APMs), Local Payment Methods (LPMs), QR-based payments, digital wallets or debit routing.
- Experience with terminal management systems, terminal security, encryption, tokenization or key-management concepts.
- Experience with Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs), payment orchestration, merchant onboarding or configuration workflows.

- This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Job Title
Head of Product Operations, EMEA

About your role:
We are seeking a highly organised, process-driven leader to own the operating spine of the EMEA Financial Solutions product function. The role leads Enablement and Product Operations across the EMEA product line. Its purpose is to make the businesses carry revenue faster in line with both client needs and product strategy, more consistent and better evidenced.

Two things sit at the centre of the role. The first is client discovery: how we work with a client to understand what they actually need, and how we hold the line that our platforms are adopted rather than adapted. The second is prioritisation coordination: taking the demands arriving from across the region, making the trade-offs visible, and getting them into one ordered view that the product businesses and the global product teams can both work from.

Around those sit the practices that keep a product organisation honest - the Product Review Committee, pricing and contract standards, documentation, training, the developer studio, the product catalogue, and the reporting and market intelligence that leadership decides from. This is a builder's role as much as a leader's one: several of these practices exist today only as a named gap.

What you’ll do:
- Client Discovery Practice - Own the EMEA client discovery method, standards, artefacts and cadence. Lead live discovery engagements with clients and business teams. Uphold adopt-not-adapt, meeting client needs without platform customisation. Make discovery insights reusable across clients. Coordinate regional discovery and efficient onboarding for smaller opportunities.
- Prioritisation and Regional Demand Coordination - Coordinate regional priorities, capturing requests, clients, deadlines and trade-offs. Lead triage with product managers using clear assessment criteria. Align with global teams on configuration, integration and core platform needs. Maintain a single, evidence-based demand view and keep requesters informed of status, dependencies and changes.
- Product Review Committee - Chair the regional committee, ensuring proposals are decision-ready. Facilitate clear decisions, ownership and next steps. Track execution, communicate outcomes and maintain the decision record.
- Pricing and Contract Standards - Ensure consistent pricing and contract terms across EMEA. Support deal reviews with clear standards, templates and evidence, working with Legal, Finance and commercial teams to manage exceptions and keep guidance current.
- Product Enablement and Documentation - Lead go-to-market collateral, RFP responses, product documentation and demos. Maintain an accurate product catalogue and consistent, high-quality artefacts.
- Reporting, KPIs and Market Intelligence - Deliver trusted leadership reporting and dashboards on product performance, risks, capacity, demand and dependencies. Maintain clear regional KPIs and current market and competitor intelligence.
- AI in the Product Function - Embed AI in team practices and product operations, identify product opportunities, and partner with Technology and global teams on responsible use in regulated financial services.
- Leading the Function - Build and lead a neutral, process-focused Product Operations function, partnering across teams to establish effective governance and champion transparency, accountability and client focus.

Experience that you’ll need to have:
- Substantial experience in Product Operations, governance or portfolio operations.
- Proven client discovery experience, translating needs into product requirements.
- Experience managing priorities and demand across competing stakeholders.
- Experience running senior decision forums and ensuring follow-through.
- Knowledge of product pricing and commercial standards, working with Legal and Finance.
- Strong understanding of product lifecycle and modern development practices.
- Experience with product and portfolio tooling and AI tooling.
- Hands-on experience building processes, producing initial analysis and artefacts, then scaling delivery through a team.

Experience that would be great to have:
- Experience in payments, banking or regulated financial services.
- Experience working across global platforms and regional markets.
- Experience in platform migration or modernisation.
- Process improvement experience.
- Experience selecting or improving product workflow tools.

Every day, Clover powers card present and omnicommerce services for hundreds of thousands of merchants in multiple countries around the world. Behind the scenes, we operate a cloud platform providing payment processing, storage, and collaboration for merchants, application developers, service providers, and our merchants' customers. Our devices and platform form the backbone of millions of payment interactions between merchants and their customers daily. We are looking for self starters with a passion for technology who want to help us impact millions of merchant’s lives one transaction at a time.

As a Product Manager for Payments at Clover, you’ll help extend our industry leadership in card present payments. What does a successful VP Head of Product – Gift Card & Stored Value at Fiserv do?
The Fiserv Gift Card & Stored Value business is responsible all closed loop stored value solutions for the Merchant Solutions division.  We serve hundreds of mid-sized and large brands globally, as well as thousands of US small business clients.
This leader must combine product vision with disciplined operating execution, commercial judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams through complex delivery commitments.  Should have a demonstrated ability to connect product strategy to revenue growth, client retention, margin expansion, product adoption, and measurable client outcomes.

What you will do:

- Product Roadmap and SDLC: Define and manage the product roadmap and SDLC with adoption of payments industry best practices.  Partner directly with Engineering to ensure high velocity and high quality product shipments to market.
- Product Partner Management: Identify, engage, and manage third party partners that can enhance our gift card and stored value propositions to program clients.  Partner management includes commercial, legal, technical and operational functions.

- Metrics driven: Develop a scorecard of leading and lagging indicators that reflects the health of the business
- Execution: Plan and execute product delivery components with precision.  Roadmap should be clear, detailed, consistently delivered, and cadenced to customer and industry schedules.
- Team Building and Culture: Build a high-performing team with a culture of customer obsession, insight, and empathy.

What you need to have:
- +12 years of experience leading product management for a scaled B2B, payments, commerce, stored value, and/or loyalty business.
- Experience translating strategy into detailed product roadmaps and release plans, with demonstrated successful adoption of SDLC best practices.
- Deep customer orientation with demonstrated experience gathering customer insight directly from enterprise clients, partner teams, and market research.
- Domain experience in payments, gift cards, stored value, e-commerce and/or mobile commerce (including digital wallets)
- People leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing product managers, including setting clear expectations, improving team discipline, and building accountability.
- Cross-functional leadership experience working effectively with Sales, Relationship Management, Client Success, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Engineering, and external partners.
- Partner management experience identifying, negotiating with, integrating, and managing technology or service partners that expand the product value proposition.

- Experience with digital gift card commerce, including e-commerce checkout, fraud controls, fulfillment, digital delivery, mobile wallet provisioning, and third-party distribution.
- Understanding of program management services, including physical card design, production, fulfillment, settlement, reporting, reconciliation, client support, and operational SLAs.
- Familiarity with payments industry requirements, including merchant processing, MCC considerations, settlement flows, data reporting, compliance, fraud prevention, and processor/platform integrations.

Job Title
Product Director, Clover Hardware

We’re looking for a Product Director to own the strategy and roadmap for Clover’s POS hardware portfolio and accessories ecosystem. This is a senior role at the intersection of hardware engineering, manufacturing, payments, and merchant experience. You’ll need to focus on how hardware decisions translate into business outcomes, including adoption, merchant satisfaction, margins, churn reduction, and competitive win rates.

You’ll define what Clover merchants use every day to run their businesses and generate revenue. And you’ll work across engineering, finance, sales, commercialization, and product marketing teams to ensure the portfolio wins in the market.

Product Strategy & Vision
- Develop a comprehensive hardware product strategy aligned with Clover’s overall mission, business priorities, and annual operating plan.

- Create a product vision and multi-year roadmap across Clover’s device portfolio and accessories ecosystem, balancing our vertical strategies, merchant needs, cost targets, and competitive positioning.

- Identify emerging trends and technological advancements that can be applied to the POS hardware space to drive competitive differentiation.

- Define our hardware accessories and peripherals strategy, spanning first-party products (such as sleeves and stands) and third-party partner integrations (such as kitchen scales). Outline attach rate goals, and build/buy/partner decisions in close coordination with industrial design, finance, and sales channel teams.

- Develop a clear point of view on hardware’s role in merchant acquisition and retention, and use that to drive prioritization decisions and investment cases.

- Represent the hardware product team in executive reviews, partner conversations, and strategic planning cycles.

Product Development & Roadmapping
- Drive the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from ideation through launch, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery of reliable, scalable, secure, and compliant hardware products.

- Collaborate with engineering and industrial design teams to define product requirements and cost targets.

- Work closely with hardware engineering, industrial design, and manufacturing partners to efficiently guide new products through the EVT, DVT, and PVT stages.

- Drive EMV and PCI certification strategy, coordinating with certification labs to ensure compliant, timely launches.

- Lead international hardware expansion planning, including regional certification requirements and competitive landscape assessment.

- Translate product delivery and roadmap execution into measurable revenue outcomes and KPI performance.

Go-To-Market
- Develop deep understanding of Clover’s target merchant segments (restaurant, retail, services, healthcare) and translate segment-level needs into hardware differentiation and go-to-market strategy.

- Partner closely with product marketing, finance, sales channels, and business development teams to align on roadmaps, positioning, value propositions, messaging, and pricing.

- Partner with hardware fulfillment teams to ensure hardware packaging and economics work for Clover’s distribution model.

Customer Focus
- Conduct in-depth market and user research to understand merchant and consumer pain points and the competitive landscape.

- Gather and analyze customer feedback, operational data, failure rates, and other telemetry data to understand opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention by delivering secure, compliant, and reliable payment experiences.

Team & Financial Leadership
- Foster a culture of data-informed decision-making that is based on the needs of our target merchants and the financial performance goals of the organization.

- Manage and develop a team of PMs focused on specific device lines or capability areas.

- Define and track KPIs spanning hardware quality and field performance through to commercial metrics — attach rates and device-linked retention.

What You Will Need to Have:
- 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on hardware or hardware-adjacent products in payments, fintech, or consumer electronics, including accessories, peripherals, or full device ecosystems.

- Experience managing hardware portfolios that span both owned products and third-party partner integrations, including vendor selection, commercial negotiation, and go-to-market coordination.

- Demonstrated ability to connect hardware decisions to business outcomes — pricing, packaging, channel fit, and merchant value proposition.

- An understanding of the payments ecosystem — EMV standards, PCI compliance, card- present transaction flows, and acquirer/network relationships.

- Experience taking hardware products through full development cycles, including ODM/OEM partnerships and certification processes.

- Strong analytical and commercial instincts — comfortable with market sizing, cost- benefit tradeoffs, build/buy/partner decisions, and business case development.

- Excellent cross-functional leadership; able to align engineering, design, sales, operations, and commercial teams around a shared roadmap.

- Experience with SMB or merchant-facing products strongly preferred.

- International product experience (EMEA, APAC, or LATAM) a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or engineering background a plus.

Travel Requirements:
This position requires the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of your time depending on business needs.
